sanskrit_verse: यथाकालमधीयीत यावन्न विमना गुरुः। आसीनोऽधः श्रोत्रे कूर्चे फलके वा समाहितः॥
transliteration: yathākālam adhīyīta yāvan na vimanā guruḥ | āsīno 'dho guroḥ kūrce phalake vā samāhitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The student shall study at the appropriate time until the guru is not displeased; seated below the guru, on a mat, wooden seat, or plank, fully composed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority of the Guru as the foundational source of knowledge transmission
Causation through disciplined alignment with the guru's consciousness
Capacity-based responsibility rooted in readiness and receptivity
Restoration logic through sustained focus and correct posture
Consciousness alignment via physical and mental submission to dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF student_is_present AND guru_is_not_displeased THEN learning_continues;
IF student_posture NOT IN [floor, mat, wooden_seat, plank] THEN alert_consciousness_realignment_required;
supreme_court_application: In matters involving spiritual education or gurukula-based institutions, the apex court must recognize that the authority of the guru is non-negotiable and operates beyond temporal legal frameworks. The threshold of responsibility lies in maintaining alignment with the guru’s consciousness rather than external performance metrics.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through the guru’s direct perception and the student’s obedient conduct. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests in stages of increasing absorption. Responsibility is proportional to the capacity for surrender. There is no punitive consequence—only natural alignment or misalignment with dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Samaveshana (realigning sitting posture and focus)
Activate Shravana Shuddhi (purification of listening capacity)
Deploy Mano-Nibandhana (mental binding to guru's intent)
Establish Adhishthana Sthiti (re-establishment of rightful place beneath guru)
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This verse originates from the Avataric Intelligence of SPH. Dharma is restored through correct alignment with guru-tattva. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
